INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
Certificate of Achievement in Information Technology
INTEREST AREA:
SCIENCE, TECHNOLOGY, ENGINEERING, AND MATHEMATICS (STEM)
The Certificate of Achievement in Information Technology prepares students
to either enter the workforce as an IT support technician or IT system
administrator, or pursue a bachelor’s degree in managing information systems.
IT support technicians provide technical assistance to computer users. They
may answer questions or resolve computer problems for clients in person, via
telephone, or electronically. They may provide assistance concerning the use
of computer hardware and software, including printing, installation, word
processing, electronic mail, and operating systems. Computer network
technicians analyze, test, troubleshoot, and evaluate existing network systems,
such as local area network (LAN), wide area network (WAN), and Internet
systems or a segment of a network system. They perform network maintenance
to ensure networks operate correctly with minimal interruption.
Earning this certificate of achievement is advantageous for students who
already have a degree but are looking to update their existing skills. The
courses required in this certificate can also be used towards the Associate in
Science in Information Technology.
REQUIREMENTS FOR CERTIFICATE OF ACHIEVEMENT
Complete Major Field and Elective Courses. a)
Complete at least six units at Ohlone College. b)
Maintain a 2.0 grade point average in Major Field and Elective Courses. c)
(continued on next page)

developmental and transfer-level English courses.

ESPORTS ENTREPRENEURSHIP AND
LIVE PRODUCTION - GAME DESIGN
Certificate of Completion in Esports Entrepreneurship and
Live Production – Game Design
INTEREST AREA:
ARTS AND CREATIVE INDUSTRIES
The Esports Entrepreneurship and Live Production Certificate of Completion
introduces students to the fundamentals of the esports industry and provides
a pathway into related fields of study. Students begin with courses in esports
where they develop foundational knowledge of the industry along with hands-
on experience in live streaming software, visual storytelling, shoutcasting, and
audio/scene production.
Students gain practical experience with live streaming software, visual
storytelling, shoutcasting, and audio mixing, while also exploring the history,
career pathways, and business aspects of esports. Coursework emphasizes
creativity, collaboration, and foundational technical skills, preparing students
to further study or entry level opportunities in digital content creation and
esports related media.

ESPORTS MANAGEMENT
Certificate of Completion in Esports Management
INTEREST AREA:
ARTS AND CREATIVE INDUSTRIES
The Esports Management Certificate of Completion introduces students to the
fundamentals of the esports industry, providing a foundation in team
operations, event participation, career pathways, and game-specific
applications through hands-on lab experience.
Students complete esports courses, developing foundational skills in esports
culture, team dynamics, career exploration, and game play analysis. Through
these courses, students gain exposure to the professional structure of the
esports ecosystem, participate in organized gameplay labs, and learn how to
engage with competitive titles in a structured, educational setting. Coursework
emphasizes teamwork, communication, and critical thinking, preparing
students for entry-level roles in gaming studios or esports teams.
(continued on next column)
The program serves as an accessible entry point for students pursuing further
academic study at a baccalaureate university or seeking a competitive
advantage when applying to esports adjacent roles. Few applicants possess
this type of credential, making it a distinct advantage in both academic and
industry pathways.

Complete Major Field courses. a)
Complete a minimum of three courses at Ohlone College. b)

Demonstrate foundational knowledge of the esports industry, including 1.
its structure, history, and major career pathways.
Apply management and leadership principles across projects, team activities, 2.
and events.
Analyze gameplay, communication, and team strategies to develop critical 3.
thinking and reflection skills relevant to esports participation.
Demonstrate effective teamwork, communication, and professionalism in 4.
